remarks: Enjoy breathtaking views of the golf course and Mount Diablo from this beautifully upgraded home, where luxury and comfort come together at every turn. Inside, high-end carpet and rich paint colors create a warm, elegant atmosphere. The versatile floor plan offers four bedrooms plus a dedicated office (Being shown as bedroom but does not have a closet)  and a large bonus room, giving everyone space to work, play, and unwind. The fully remodeled primary bathroom is absolutely stunning, featuring a freestanding soaking tub, custom tile shower, and heated tile floors for a true spa-like retreat.
